summary.text: Joe Gedeon was selected to complete the remainder of the late Representative Gene Ward's term in the Hawaii House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He was born and raised in Hawaii Kai, graduated from Kaiser High School in 1997, and is an Eagle Scout.

According to the legislative biography, he is co-founder, partner and vice president of sales and marketing at JPG Hawaii, a printing and signage company, and previously served as president of the Rotary Club of Waikiki.
